name: Brawn Way and Faber Lane

layers.essential_history: [[c:Many of Elton's newer streets are named after village people and businesses. Brawn Way remembers William Brawn, the first headmaster of the village school in 1876.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Vinco Terrace is named after the Vinco Cycle Works, which employed more than 30 men before becoming a motor garage.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A carter mending a wheel tells you Master Hale was asking, very politely, how far it is to London and how fast a letter could get there.]]

sources.title: Elton Parish Council: A short history of Elton

directions_to_next: [[c:Head south-east, about 290 metres as the crow flies, to Highgate Green and Highgate Hall. Head east to Highgate Green; the hall is by the main road. Keep to the pavements and paths.]]
